dialogue.line: They said it was the only way to go home!
Sara, just tell me what you did.
I saw something that wasn't there.
standing in the middle of the road, staring at me.
I am not saying ignore it.
You already got people's hopes up with your goddamn tower.
All the more reason that we...
To keep our fucking mouths shut.
Where's my mom? I want my mom!
I spent the entire night with her,
and that scalpel she used, she took it from my clinic.
How exactly are you gonna tell Kenny
I did what I had to do! She was valuable!
She... she may still be valuable!
They tore him to pieces, and you knew!
You watch your own fucking six.
There's a symbol that I keep seeing.
he must have been seeing it, too.
This could be the key to getting the hell out of here.
There really is no way out.
Hi. Are you comfortable in there?
What am I supposed to be?
Huh? Am I supposed to be pissing myself? Huh?
Heh. Well, you can't get in here,
'cause there's a fucking rock in the fucking window!
Yeah. Yeah, that's real fucking scary.
Don't fucking walk away from me.
You don't fucking walk away from me!
Hey, hey, can we just calm down?
There's a lot about this that you don't understand.
Kenny told us. She's a fucking murderer.
That's what she is. How could you do this?
She is not going to hurt anyone!
I don't give a shit what she's gonna do!
All I care about is what she's done.
She tried to kill my fucking kid!
Yes, I know. I know. I know. I know. I know. I know. I know.
We just supposed to pretend like nothing happened?
a fucking tower, on Colony House
and told everyone they were going home!
Now, they're all looking at me, wondering why
I didn't come back with all the answers!
We got a busload of people we don't have resources for,
and a fucking house fell for no goddamn reason!
So, yeah, if she can help us figure out what's going on here,
she stays out of the Box! Period!
You need to listen very fucking carefully.
If you ever come near my family again,
I swear to God I will fucking kill you!
I don't give a shit about your word!
You lock the door. You stay inside.
I want to make sure she hears this from my mouth.
I'm not strong enough for this.
That part I can't help you with,
so you better figure it out!
Ethan, I promise if you let me in,
Ethan, come on. Please let me in.
He heard us last night talking about Sara.
Honey, I promise no one's going to hurt you.
Yeah. Your mom and I, we're never gonna let anybody
It's like, uh, with the Cromenockle?
When she's afraid to go inside of the cave.
chocolate chip, but they're the best I could do.
Okay. So, they're these bread crisps that Tian-Chen makes.
They're, like, a cross between a cracker and a chip.
Right? Okay. Don't get crumbs in the bed.
I have a surprise for you.
How... how... how do even you have this?
Are you kidding? I haven't gone anywhere without it
I still remember the last time I saw you wearing it.
What if I'm not the same anymore?
I've had to do things that...
the one who killed her brother.
You can't have your house back. Look. She has my coat.
Put it down and get the fuck out.
The rest of your stuff is gone. We packed it up.
We... we gave it to Kenny's mom for storage.
There was this small ceramic ornament about this big.
He just fucking told you no!
Look. It was creepy having your stuff here,
and it's really creepy that you're here right now,
so please just put the coat down and go away.
I'm trying to figure out the symbol
that you refuse to help me with,
despite the fact that you clearly know something
Well, I'll tell you what I can.
First, you have to do something for me.
So, now you need something from me, you're...
You know what? First of all, fuck off,
and second of all, fuck off!
The fuck is wrong with you?
If you play, I'll tell you about the man in the photo.
You tell me about the photo first. Then I play.
Just give me the fuckin' violin.
This took me all fucking night.
There's no way I'm letting him anywhere near that...
How can you even consider this, Jim?
that we should let him lead sometimes,
and they also said that we have to let him
work through things in his own way
and to be there to support him when he asks.
Anyways, I'll be there, right there with him.
Look. I don't give a shit what the doctors said.
We're living in a fucking nightmare,
and that bitch tried to kill my kid.
I remember what you told me yesterday
about this place, how scary it is.
we have to face the scary things.
That's how you take their power away.
And do exactly what he tells you.
What were you fucking doing, Boyd?
By the rules of this town,
that girl should have gone in the Box
Don't you lay this on him.
You made your own call here, Boyd.
You told people you were coming back with answers,
and instead, you came back with a psychopath
who killed not one but four people.
And because she's special, she doesn't have to go
in the Box? Do you hear what that sounds like?
Out in the forest, she knew things
I mean, we're still fuckin' here.
do you see a yellow brick fuckin' road leading us home?
I just see someone who may have just betrayed
the one thing this place still has going for it.
I don't think this has anything to do with going home.
I think this is about Abby.
I think you shot your wife,
you wake up wishing you'd done more,
that you'd been there for her,
You gonna have my back on this or not?
You want my approval? Y-You want absolution?
'Cause you're not gonna get it here.
What the hell is that supposed to mean?
How does she feel about Sara being back?
He has something he wants to say to you.
Only monsters live in the woods.
And I'm not afraid of you.
Listen. You want me to play something for you, I'll play,
but I'm not gonna wander around with you all day while you...
I... I didn't want to look at the cars anymore,
so I put them where I couldn't see them.
I'm sorry about what happened yesterday.
I don't like when people touch my things,
and when I heard you play...
What do you, uh... What do you wanna hear?
Play the one about the star.
She used to play it when I was afraid.
And I'd sit up here, just like this,
when I heard the people screaming,
she'd tell me to think about the twinkling stars.
And then... I wouldn't be afraid anymore.
I didn't think anyone would be here.
Do you live here in town?
I mean, obviously, you... you live in town.
I hadn't seen you up at the Colony House.
I guess right now, I live here.
I figured a priest would live here
I go every Sunday with my grandma.
As long as I can remember.
Is that where you were going when you were on the bus?
I go see her every weekend.
I was never all that religious,
but... it always made her happy,
you know, me going to church with her,
and afterwards, we'd spend the afternoon sitting outside,
Uh, she would give them to every person that she met.
And I... I would tell her,
"Grandma, maybe we could try to switch it up a little bit.
Maybe try a dog or a bunny or something."
You must think I'm really cool.
I was kind of a dork when I was a kid.
we used to collect these little ceramic Christmas ornaments
from the dollar store in town.
We'd save up all our money.
We'd go every chance we got, like, all year round.
We wouldn't even wait for Christmas.
And then we'd get home, and we would paint them
We had so many at one point,
we could've decorated a hundred trees
and still had some left over.
Nathan's always looked a lot better than mine.
I thought they were all gone.
Nathan kept one with him all these years.
He said it reminded him of a time when things were...
I think the person who has it won't wanna give it back.
You need some muscle, I'm happy to talk to 'em.
How come you don't stay up at the Colony House?
I mean, the people up there seem friendly, for the most part.
No reason to be hanging around an old, musty church.
It always seemed like such a nice idea...
that no matter what you did...
a bit like wishful thinking to me.
Why? Did you do something that needs forgiving?
It was really nice to meet you, Elgin.
Oh, baby, I'm so proud of you.
Can you come help me peel some potatoes for dinner?
You never come here, this place.
You weren't doing anything what? Give me that.
What the fuck is in it?
Give me that.  Your stuff? Huh?
Give me it. Give me it.
This mean a lot to you?
I don't care what Boyd says, and I don't give a shit
how fucking special you think you are.
You ever come near my mom again, and I swear to God
I will drag your fucking psycho ass into that Box myself.
Keep in mind... I'm a little out of practice.
Hi. I... I was looking for Kristi.
Sorry. I didn't mean to interrupt.
Oh, no. It's fine.  How can I help you?
I was hoping I could give you this.
Uh, why are you carrying around liquid morphine?
Mm. Um, when were you diagnosed?
I figure that by the time I need that,
I probably won't be in any shape to...
I'll take care of it, okay?
I'll let you get back to it.
Oh, well, you're better off in here, anyway.
Oh, there's lots of hubbub flying around
now that that Sara girl's back.
and then she tried to kill a little boy because I...
We were talking one night. She was at the clinic,
and... and she asked me what I would do to see you again.
If it was something bad, would it be worth it?
and then the next day, she... Fuck.
I just wanted to see you again so badly that I...
I wasn't even listening to the question,
and now, you're here, and I'm wondering
if that's my fault, too. And I just...
No. I just feel like all I've been doing lately is
He seemed nice at first, 'cause he made people laugh.
That... that wasn't an easy thing to do back then.
I don't like this. Uh, we should go back.
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa. Wait, wait, wait, wait, wait.
Right? I played your song. I held up my end.
You shouldn't be asking these questions.
Look. I haven't had a good night's sleep
since I fucking got here, and I'm... and I'm seeing things,
things that are scaring the shit out of me.
And it's... and it's all because of this, right here!
And whoever this Christopher guy was, he saw it, too!
He saw it. He obsessed over it.
He drew it a thousand fucking times.
So you playing your whole weird, creepy mystery man routine,
it's not exactly helping me feel any better!
When did he start seeing the symbol?
I know these things are scary,
and... I know that these aren't things
that you really want to talk about, but...
I am at the end of my rope.
When Christopher started seeing that symbol,
and he didn't make people laugh anymore.
One night, my mother told me to hide somewhere new,
somewhere different, somewhere Christopher didn't know,
and when I woke up the next morning, everyone...
They make people do bad things.
No, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no!
Don't touch me! Don't touch me! Don't! Don't! Don't, please!
Don't, don't, don't, don't, don't, don't, don't!
Don't touch me! Don't touch me! Don't touch me!
No, no, no! Don't touch me! Don't touch me!
Don't touch me! Please don't touch me! Don't touch me!
Your nose is... your nose is bleeding.
Did you see that? Did you see them? Where the fuck...
Look. I don't wanna do this right now, Jim.
I mean, I don't agree with what you did, but...
but I looked at that girl today,
and I didn't see a psychopath.
I didn't see a vicious killer.
I'm seeing a lot of people pushed to their edge.
You ever wonder if maybe that's the point?
We heard a voice on the radio.
right as the storm was coming in,
and whoever it was, he knew my name,
knew what my wife was doing in the house,
in the basement of our house.
And I thought maybe I was crazy.
I think people are watching us.
Now, there are experiments like this
going all the way back to World War II.
Look. We don't have to trust each other.
We don't even have to like each other.
But we've gotta start working together on this.
Now, I don't know what they want from us,
but if you can give me a more rational explanation
for what's going on here, I'd love to hear it.
I was hoping we could talk.
